reason: Bugfix: `if ok != total or v.returncode != 0:` exited with error even when `untrusted_only` (`CSSMERR_TP_NOT_TRUSTED` self-signed cert) was true at line 170; Rust `verify_succeeded` allows `exit_code != 0` when `untrusted_only` is true (matching `build-copy.py:371`).
Bugfix: PowerShell 5.1 `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8` wrote UTF-8 BOM into patched `.js` and `index.html`; Rust `install_ion_dir` always writes clean UTF-8 without BOM.

Security & CLI parity unification: unified Windows injection with `inject-cn.js` so Windows also verifies `process.execPath` canonical equality before evaluating `hook.js`, supports `--attach`, `--no-launch`, `--user-data-dir`, `CODEX_PLUS_CLAUDE_VOICE_INPUT`, and `CODEX_PLUS_CLAUDE_LOCALIZATION`.
